svg.title: CLARA interval selection and full-information feedback
svg.desc: Forecast context supplies six candidate calibration intervals and the state used by CLARA. Historical coverage determines candidate eligibility; uncertainty-adjusted conditional costs rank the retained candidates. All six intervals are saved at release and evaluated when their observations become available. The contextual calibration landscape stores cost, uncertainty, support, and coverage evidence. Fitted cost and coverage estimates remain fixed in GEFCom testing and are updated with eligible local feedback in local operation.
